top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and identification of its active form (Holst, Mojsov, Drucker) is a mature, transformative body of work whose clinical consequence in type 2 diabetes and obesity is established at scale. The three-laureate allocation fits the discovery-level scientific contributions, and the citation is scoped to physiology and the active peptide rather than to drug development. An award is clearly preferable to no award.
